portal.name: Department of Empowerment of Persons with Disabilities
portal.owner: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
portal.task: Find the Public Grievance page from the home page
portal.notes: The department responsible for accessibility policy. Its default home page is in Hindi; this task uses the English one. The Public Grievance link sits in a drop-down sub-menu that is closed when the page loads.
